claims: LAFC advanced to the 2026 Concacaf Champions Cup semifinals.
LAFC had a 1-1 draw (4-1 agg) with Cruz Azul on April 14, 2026.

LAFC's starting XI featured Hugo Lloris, Sergi Palencia, Ryan Porteous, Nkosi Tafari, Eddie Segura, Mathieu Choinière, Marco Delgado, Timothy Tillman, David Martínez, Denis Bouanga, and Heung-Min Son.
